about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of ONLY UP: BRAINROT TOGETHER!

The main hero Tung Tung Sahur and his friends are up against the impossible — to climb to the top and reach the peak. But the path upward won't be easy: at every step, chaotic monstrosities like Bombardino Cocodrilo, Spijuniro Golubiro, and other creatures lie in wait!

Gather a team of up to 8 players and embark on a psychedelic ascent through levels where every inch is a challenge, and every fallen comrade is a source of pure roflotherapy.

Only up — while your brain still holds on!

Your sense of timing, coordination, and inner resilience will be crucial. The levels are designed to drive even the toughest players insane. Every jump and fail is a step toward personal breakthrough — or breakdown.

Features:

  • Multiplayer: Climb together! Up to 8 players suffering at the same time create the perfect atmosphere of collective madness.

  • Troll mechanics: Push your friend into the abyss and watch their reaction!

  • Save system: Every time you throw an enemy into the void, you anchor your "checkpoint" and can teleport back to it!

  • Graphics: Dive into the neon wastelands of brainrot worlds — the hallucination is guaranteed.

  • Optimization: Runs even on a toaster.

  • Community connection: Hop into our Discord — a place to chat with the devs and meet fellow sufferers.

Defeat your inner demons and become a living legend of the climb! Let Spijuniro Golubiro and the rest tremble at the sound of your name!

© 2025. All rights reserved.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 2.4GHz Dual-Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2 ГБ
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: For best performance, you should download the latest NVIDIA or AMD drivers (depending on your graphics card)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 4GHz Quad-Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 8GB
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: For best performance, you should download the latest NVIDIA or AMD drivers (depending on your graphics card)

short_description: ONLY UP: BRAINROT TOGETHER is a chaotic multiplayer climbing adventure for up to 8 players. Navigate surreal levels, avoid traps, and survive encounters with bizarre brainrot creatures. Precision, timing, and teamwork are your only way up.
